file2 <- file.path("/data_2/scratch/ting/veg_topo_data/data_raw/airborne_lidar_lang_2023/airborne_lidar/ALS_MaxGEDIFootprint_GSD10m/32TMS.tif")

```{r}
plot_top_percent <- function(r, 
                             file_path = NULL,
                             percentile = 0.99, 
                             plot_type = "hex",  # "hex" 或 "scatter"
                             bins = 100, 
                             exclude_extreme = FALSE, 
                             extreme_threshold = 5000,
                             alpha = 0.6) {
  
  # 提取所有值（向量形式）
  vals <- values(r, matlab = FALSE)
  
  # 记录原始非NA数量
  original_non_na <- sum(!is.na(vals))
  
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat("Processing:", basename(file_path), "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")
  
  # 可选：排除极端异常值
  if(exclude_extreme) {
    extreme_count <- sum(vals > extreme_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
    if(extreme_count > 0) {
      cat("Excluding", extreme_count, "cells with values >", extreme_threshold, "m\n")
      vals[vals > extreme_threshold] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  # 计算分位数阈值
  thresh <- quantile(vals, percentile, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # 提取最高百分比的数据
  top <- vals[vals >= thresh]
  
  # 输出统计信息
  cat("\n========== Top", (1 - percentile) * 100, "% Statistics ==========\n")
  cat("Percentile threshold:", percentile * 100, "%\n")
  cat("Threshold value:", round(thresh, 2), "m\n")
  cat("Number of cells in top", (1 - percentile) * 100, "%:", length(top), "\n")
  cat("Percentage of non-NA cells:", round(length(top) / sum(!is.na(vals)) * 100, 2), "%\n\n")
  print(summary(top))
  cat("\n")
  
  # 准备数据框用于绘图
  df_top <- data.frame(
    x = 1:length(top),
    y = top
  )
  
  # 根据 plot_type 选择绘图类型
  if(plot_type == "hex") {
    # Hexbin图
    p <- ggplot(df_top, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_hex(bins = bins) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c() +
      labs(title = paste0(basename(file_path), " - Top ", (1 - percentile) * 100, "% Canopy Height"),
           subtitle = paste0(percentile * 100, "th percentile threshold: ", round(thresh, 2), " m",
                            ifelse(exclude_extreme, paste0(" | Excluded > ", extreme_threshold, " m"), "")),
           x = "Data Point Index",
           y = "Height (m)",
           fill = "Count") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    
  } else if(plot_type == "scatter") {
    # 散点图（抽样显示，避免过密）
    # 如果数据点太多，随机抽样100000个点以提高绘图速度
    if(nrow(df_top) > 200000) {
      cat("Too many points (", nrow(df_top), "), sampling 200,000 points for scatter plot\n", sep = "")
      set.seed(123)
      df_top <- df_top[sample(1:nrow(df_top), 200000), ]
    }
    
    p <- ggplot(df_top, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 0.5, alpha = alpha) +
      labs(title = paste0(basename(file_path), " - Top ", (1 - percentile) * 100, "% Canopy Height"),
           subtitle = paste0(percentile * 100, "th percentile threshold: ", round(thresh, 2), " m",
                            ifelse(exclude_extreme, paste0(" | Excluded > ", extreme_threshold, " m"), "")),
           x = "Data Point Index",
           y = "Height (m)") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    
  } else {
    stop("plot_type must be either 'hex' or 'scatter'")
  }
  
  # 打印图形
  print(p)
  
  # 返回结果
  invisible(list(
    data = top,
    threshold = thresh,
    summary = summary(top),
    plot = p,
    plot_type = plot_type
  ))
}
```

```{r}
plot_top_percent (r1, file_path = file1, 0.99)
```

```{r}
plot_top_percent (r2,  file_path = file2, 0.98)
```

```{r}

                  file_path = file1,
                  percentile = 0.99,
                  plot_type = "scatter",
                  exclude_extreme = TRUE,
                  extreme_threshold = 5000,
                  alpha = 0.3)
```

```{r}
plot_top_percent (r2, 
                  file_path = file2,
                  percentile = 0.98,
                  plot_type = "scatter",
                  exclude_extreme = TRUE,
                  extreme_threshold = 900,
                  alpha = 0.3)

```

```{r}
r1_clean <- r1
r1_clean[r1_clean < 0] <- NA
r1_clean[r1_clean > 70] <- NA

plot_top_percent (r1_clean, 
                  file_path = file1,
                  percentile = 0.99,
                  plot_type = "scatter",
                  alpha = 0.3)
plot(r1_clean)
r1_clean 
```

r2_clean[r2_clean > 70] <- NA
